title: You Think Memory Has Fixed Storage Space, Yet Grouping Facts Quadruples What You Hold
description:
You think short-term memory works like raw storage space! Yet smart grouping quadrupled recall without changing brain size! This is the true story of George Miller's discovery. Here is what went wrong with early computer myths.
